title: Origin: Crytter
description: Origin datapack that adds the Crytter origin
body:
This datapack adds the Crytter origin, small cave critters that grow shiny junk (crystals).

Made for the 2025/26 Origins: Caved In jam

Please make sure to go to the Versions tab to download the resource pack.

## 💎 Abilities 💎
### Crystal Charge
You slowly grow crystal charges when in caves (or below y=30 in the overworld), up to a max of 7.
You can break amethyst clusters by using Right Click with an empty hand to gain 1 crystal charge.

### Crystal Armour
After 10 seconds of not taking damage, consumes 1 crystal charge to gain crystal armour. This protects you against one instance of damage, reducing it to 1 and shattering after.
### Crystal Dart
Use your Primary Active key to consume 1 crystal charge and fire a small but accurate crystal dart. Hitting an entity with the dart deals light damage and restores 1 crystal charge after a short delay.
### Strong Stomach
You are able to consume amethyst shards for sustenance.
### Small Stature
Your body is smaller than most, allowing you to fit into tight crevices, and reducing your max health by 3 hearts.
### Cave Dweller
Being exposed to the sky weakens you.
#### Hidden Powers
You gain night vision when in caves (or below y=30 in the overworld).
